Map showing locations of community kitchens available for rent in Manitoba.  
  
  This map shows the locations of community kitchens available for rent in Manitoba. Each kitchen has a Food Service Establishment permit issued by Manitoba Health, and is a suitable facility to produce value-added food products for sale. For more information visit Manitoba Agriculture. This map is used in the Commercial Community Kitchens in Manitoba application.
